At UW-Superior, you’re more than a number. Here, you’ll receive one-on-one attention from your professors, hands-on learning experiences, countless opportunities to get involved and so much more. And with more than 50 undergraduate and graduate programs to choose from, there’s something for everyone. In short, we have everything you need to start your path toward a bright future.

Start Your Journey

Undergraduate

Choosing a college to attend after high school isn’t easy, but know that at UW-Superior, we’ll put you front and center at every stage.

Graduate

At UW-Superior, we have graduate programs tailored to launch or advance your career. Your success is our goal.

Transfer

Whether you’re transferring from a community college or another four-year program, UW-Superior is here to help you through the process.

International

Did you know international students make up a large part of our student population? Find out why so many make UW-Superior their university of choice.

Veterans and Nontraditional Students

It can be challenging for adult and military learners to return to college or begin their educational journey. UW-Superior strives to make your transition as easy as possible.

High School (Early College Credit)

High school students at public and private high schools can earn college credit while still in high school through UW-Superior’s Early College Credit Program. 

Non-Degree Seeking Students

Want to take courses without the commitment of a degree? Pursue your passions or prep for what’s next at UW-Superior—without enrolling in a degree program.
